levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.shortDesc: Gives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
levitate.desc: User takes no damage from Ground-type moves. User is also considered ungrounded and thus unaffected by entry hazards or terrain.

whitesmoke.name: White Smoke
whitesmoke.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
whitesmoke.desc: User's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. If user is in the lead, reduces wild Pokémon encounter rate by 50%.

swiftswim.name: Swift Swim
swiftswim.shortDesc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in rain.
swiftswim.desc: User's Speed stat is doubled during Rain.

filter.name: Filter
filter.desc: User takes 0.75x damage from super-effective attacks.

cloudnine.name: Cloud Nine
cloudnine.shortDesc: Eliminates the effects of weather and terrain.
cloudnine.desc: When user is on the field, all effects of the current Weather are nullified. The Weather itself is not nullified.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.shortDesc: Sharply boosts SpAtk when a stat is lowered.
competitive.desc: When user's stats are lowered by an opponent, their Special Attack raises by two stages.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.shortDesc: Poison hits Steel/Poison for 1x and can poison them.
corrosion.desc: User's Poison-type moves deal 1x damage against Steel or Poison types. User can also poison and badly poison Steel and Poison types.

sandspit.name: Sand Spit
sandspit.shortDesc: Creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
sandspit.desc: User summons a Sandstorm for 5 turns when hit by an attack, unless a Sandstorm is already present. User takes no damage from Sandstorm.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.desc: When user is poisoned, burned, frostbitten or paralyzed by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will also become afflicted with the same status.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.shortDesc: Ups Atk and Speed if a hit makes its HP <50%.
vengeful.desc: Ups Atk and Speed if a hit makes its HP <50%.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.shortDesc: It cannot be knocked out with one hit.
sturdy.desc: User will always survive attacks with 1 HP if it has full HP, and is also immune to One-Hit Knockout moves.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.shortDesc: Ignores any stat changes in the Pokémon.
unaware.desc: User ignores Evasion, Defense and Special Defense stat stages of the target when attacking. User ignores Accuracy, Attack and Special Attack stat stages of the attacker when being attacked.

liquidooze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquidooze.shortDesc: Damages attackers using any draining move.
liquidooze.desc: When user is hit by an HP-draining move or effect, the attacker loses HP equal to the amount they would have been healed for instead.

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.shortDesc: Shields the Pokémon from one contact move.
ethereal.desc: User will be immune to the first contact move they are hit with. This shield is restored on switch-out.

innardsout.name: Innards Out
innardsout.shortDesc: Damages an attacker that lands the finishing hit.
innardsout.desc: When user faints, deal damage equal to the HP they had remaining before the last attack to the attacker.

keeneye.name: Keen Eye
keeneye.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering accuracy.
keeneye.desc: User's Accuracy stat cannot be lowered by other Pokémon and they will ignore any Evasion stat boosts when attacking. If user is in the lead, has 50% chance to prevent random encounters from Pokémon 5 or more levels lower.

galvanize.name: Galvanize
galvanize.shortDesc: Normal-type moves become Electric-type and powered.
galvanize.desc: User's Normal-type moves become Electric-type and deal 1.2x damage.

battery.name: Battery
battery.shortDesc: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.
battery.desc: When user is on the field, all other allies deal 1.3x damage with Special moves.

download.name: Download
download.shortDesc: Adjusts power according to a foe's defenses.
download.desc: When entering the field, raises Attack by one stage if foes' average Defense is lower than Special Defense, otherwise it raises Special Attack by one stage.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.shortDesc: When its stats are lowered its Attack increases.
defiant.desc: When user's stats are lowered by an opponent, their Attack raises by two stages.

naturalcure.name: Natural Cure
naturalcure.shortDesc: All status problems heal when it switches out.
naturalcure.desc: All status problems heal when it switches out.

leadership.name: Leadership
leadership.shortDesc: On switch-in, user gains priority for first move.
leadership.desc: On switch-in, user gains priority for first move.

leechingfangs.name: Leeching Fangs
leechingfangs.shortDesc: Restores 1/8 life with every biting contact move.
leechingfangs.desc: When the user damages a target with moves that have both the Biting and Contact flags, they recover HP equal to 1/8 of their target's max HP.

sandrush.name: Sand Rush
sandrush.shortDesc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in a sandstorm.
sandrush.desc: User's Speed stat is doubled during a Sandstorm. User takes no damage from Sandstorm.

stormdrain.name: Storm Drain
stormdrain.shortDesc: Draws in all Water-type moves to up SpAtk.
stormdrain.desc: User redirects all single target Water-type moves towards itself and is immune to Water-type moves. When hit by a Water-type move, their Special Attack is increased by one stage. If user is in the lead, has 50% chance to force wild encounters to be Water types.

effectspore.name: Effect Spore
effectspore.shortDesc: Contact may cause poison, paralysis or sleep.
effectspore.desc: When user is hit by a contact move, there's a 30% chance to either poison, paralyze, or sleep the attacker.

damp.name: Damp
damp.shortDesc: Prevents the use of self-destructing moves and sets up Water Sport.
damp.desc: When user is on the field, self-destructing moves from all Pokémon on both sides will always fail. Additionally, user sets up Water Sport for 5 turns when entering the field.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.shortDesc: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.
regenerator.desc: User recovers 33% of their max HP when switched out.

waterabsorb.name: Water Absorb
waterabsorb.shortDesc: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move.
waterabsorb.desc: User is immune to Water-type moves, when hit by a Water-type move they get healed for 1/4 of their max HP.

poisontouch.name: Poison Touch
poisontouch.shortDesc: May poison targets when a Pokémon makes contact.
poisontouch.desc: When user hits an enemy with a contact move, there's a 30% chance to poison the target.

stakeout.name: Stakeout
stakeout.shortDesc: Deals 30% more damage on target's first turn.
stakeout.desc: User deals 30% more damage to the target if it is their first turn on the field. Also applies on the turn the target switches in (turn 0).

clearbody.name: Clear Body
clearbody.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
clearbody.desc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

snowcloak.name: Snow Cloak
snowcloak.desc: User gets 1.5x Special Defense during Hail. User takes no damage from Hail. If user is in the lead, reduces wild Pokémon encounter rate by 50% on areas with Hail.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.shortDesc: On KO, Attack is boosted once per switch-in.
moxie.desc: On KO, Attack is boosted once per switch-in.

friendguard.name: Friend Guard
friendguard.desc: When user is on the field, all other allies take 0.75x damage.

serenegrace.name: Serene Grace
serenegrace.shortDesc: Moves' effect chance x2 but dmg lower by chance%.
serenegrace.desc: User's damaging moves with additional effects get the chance of said effects activating doubled, however, said moves will also deal reduced damage equal to the effect's original infliction chance. Does not affect moves that already have a 100% chance of triggering their effects.

longreach.name: Long Reach
longreach.shortDesc: Uses moves without making contact with the target.
longreach.desc: User's moves lose the Contact flag if they had it. User is also immune to most harmful effects that proc upon attacking an enemy.

ironfist.name: Iron Fist
ironfist.shortDesc: Boosts the power of punching moves.
ironfist.desc: User's moves with the Punching flag deal 1.2x damage.

baddreams.name: Bad Dreams
baddreams.desc: When user is on the field, all adjacent opponents that are asleep will lose 1/8 max HP each turn.

tormented.name: Tormented
tormented.shortDesc: Boosts the SpAtk stat but lowers accuracy.
tormented.desc: User has 1.5x Special Attack but 0.8x Accuracy with special moves.

static.name: Static
static.shortDesc: Contact with the Pokémon may cause paralysis.
static.desc: When user is hit by a contact move, there's a 30% chance to paralyze the attacker.

tintedlens.name: Tinted Lens
tintedlens.shortDesc: Powers up not very effective moves.
tintedlens.desc: User's not very effective moves deal 2x damage.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.shortDesc: May create another Berry after one is used.
harvest.desc: At the end of each turn, the user has a 50% chance to restore the last Berry they consumed during the battle. During Harsh Sunlight this chance becomes 100%. If user is in the lead, has 50% chance to force wild encounters to be Grass types.

blacklight.name: Black Light
blacklight.shortDesc: Light moves become 1.2x power Dark moves.
blacklight.desc: User's Light-type moves become Dark-type and deal 1.2x damage.

angerpoint.name: Anger Point
angerpoint.shortDesc: Maxes Attack after taking a critical hit.
angerpoint.desc: Maxes Attack after taking a critical hit.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.shortDesc: Normal moves become Light-type and 1.2x boost.
illuminate.desc: User's Normal-type moves become Light-type and deal 1.2x damage. If user is in the lead, reduces wild Pokémon encounter rate by 50%.

impenetrable.name: Impenetrable
impenetrable.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering Def/SpDef.
impenetrable.desc: User's Defense and Special Defense stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.shortDesc: The Pokémon raises the foe's PP usage.
pressure.desc: When user is on the field, opponents' moves will consume twice as much PP.

sandstream.name: Sand Stream
sandstream.shortDesc: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm in battle.
sandstream.desc: User summons a Sandstorm for 5 turns when entering the field, unless a Sandstorm is already present. User takes no damage from Sandstorm.

forcefield.name: Force Field
forcefield.shortDesc: Inflicts damage to the foe on special hit.
forcefield.desc: When user is hit by a special move, attacker takes damage equal to 1/8 of their max HP.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.shortDesc: Passes through the foe's barrier and strikes.
infiltrator.desc: User's moves will ignore the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Mist and Safeguard, and will also bypass Substitutes.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.shortDesc: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit.
aftermath.desc: When user is KO'ed by a contact move, the attacker loses 1/4 of their max HP.

attunement.name: Attunement
attunement.shortDesc: Boosts SpAtk if there is a status problem.
attunement.desc: User gets 1.5x Special Attack when under any status condition. The user also does not have its Special Attack lowered when frostbitten.

steamengine.name: Steam Engine
steamengine.shortDesc: Boosts Speed when hit by a Fire or Water-type move.
steamengine.desc: When user is hit by a Fire or Water-type move, their Speed is increased by six stages. When user is in the party, eggs hatch twice as fast.

regrowth.name: Regrowth
regrowth.shortDesc: Regains 1/16 max HP or lowered stats each turn.
regrowth.desc: All of user's lowered stats are restored by 1 stage at the end of each turn, if user has no lowered stats regain 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn instead.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.shortDesc: Powers up Water-type moves in a pinch.
torrent.desc: User's Water-type moves deal 1.5x damage when they have 1/3 or less HP remaining.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.desc: Lowers all adjacent foes' Attack stat by one stage when user enters the field. If user is in the lead, has 50% chance to prevent random encounters from Pokémon 5 or more levels lower.

icyveins.name: Icy Veins
icyveins.desc: User's moves deal 1.3x damage during Hail. User takes no damage from Hail.

icebody.name: Ice Body
icebody.shortDesc: The Pokémon regains 1/8 max HP in hail.
icebody.desc: User regains 1/8 max HP every turn during Hail. User takes no damage from Hail.

orbit.name: Orbit
orbit.desc: User sets up Gravity for 5 turns when entering the field, unless Gravity is already in effect.

flamebody.name: Flame Body
flamebody.shortDesc: Physical moves may burn the attacker.
flamebody.desc: When user is hit by a physical move, there's a 30% chance to burn the attacker. When user is in the party, eggs hatch twice as fast.

realism.name: Realism
realism.shortDesc: Halves damage from Ghost and Fairy-type moves.
realism.desc: Halves damage from Ghost and Fairy-type moves.

moldbreaker.name: Mold Breaker
moldbreaker.shortDesc: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.
moldbreaker.desc: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.shortDesc: Gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.
soundproof.desc: Gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.

guts.name: Guts
guts.shortDesc: Boosts Attack if there is a status problem.
guts.desc: User gets 1.5x Attack when under any non-volatile status condition. The user also does not have its Attack lowered when burned.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.shortDesc: Powers up Bug-type moves in a pinch.
swarm.desc: User's Bug-type moves deal 1.5x damage when they have 1/3 or less HP remaining.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.shortDesc: Powers up moves if they become critical hits.

impulsive.name: Impulsive
impulsive.shortDesc: 1.4x damage, but lowers used stat after attacking.
impulsive.desc: User deals 1.4x damage with their moves, but their Attack will be lowered by one stage after using physical moves, and their Special Attack will be lowered by one stage after using special moves.

trace.name: Trace
trace.shortDesc: The Pokémon copies a foe's Ability.
trace.desc: The Pokémon copies a foe's Ability.

innerfocus.name: Inner Focus
innerfocus.desc: Prevents the user from flinching. The user is also immune to Intimidate and Dishearten.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.shortDesc: Prevents problems with status in rainy weather.
hydration.desc: User will recover from any non-volatile status effects it's suffering from at the end of each turn during Rain.

dishearten.name: Dishearten
dishearten.desc: Lowers all adjacent foes' Special Attack stat by one stage when user enters the field.

dryskin.name: Dry Skin
dryskin.shortDesc: Reduces HP if it is hot. Water restores HP.
dryskin.desc: User heals 1/8 HP each turn during Rain and is immune to Water-type moves, when hit by a Water-type move they get healed for 1/4 of their max HP. User loses 1/8 HP each turn during Harsh Sunlight and takes 1.25x damage from Fire-type moves.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.shortDesc: Encourages the early use of a held Berry.
gluttony.desc: User eats berries that are usually eaten at 25% HP at 50% HP instead.

windrider.name: Wind Rider
windrider.shortDesc: Absorbs Flying moves: heals 1/4 max HP instead.
windrider.desc: If user is targeted by a Flying-type move, it is immune to that move and heals 1/4 of its maximum HP instead.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.shortDesc: Raises Speed if a held item is used up or lost.
unburden.desc: When user uses or loses a held item (except when it's traded for another), their Speed stat is doubled until they switch out or gain an item.

shadowtag.name: Shadow Tag
shadowtag.desc: When user is on the field, all adjacent opponents cannot switch out or escape.

cottondown.name: Cotton Down
cottondown.shortDesc: Lowers everyone else's Speed when attacked.
cottondown.desc: Lowers everyone else's Speed when attacked.

sandveil.name: Sand Veil
sandveil.desc: User gets 1.5x Defense during a Sandstorm. User takes no damage from Sandstorm. If user is in the lead, reduces wild Pokémon encounter rate by 50% on areas with a Sandstorm.

roughskin.name: Rough Skin
roughskin.shortDesc: Inflicts damage to the foe on physical hit.
roughskin.desc: When user is hit by a physical move, attacker takes damage equal to 1/8 of their max HP.

toughclaws.name: Tough Claws
toughclaws.shortDesc: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
toughclaws.desc: User's moves that make contact deal 1.3x damage.

speedboost.name: Speed Boost
speedboost.shortDesc: Its Speed stat is gradually boosted.
speedboost.desc: At the end of every turn, user's Speed is raised by one stage.

intuition.name: Intuition
intuition.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering SpAtk.
intuition.desc: User's Special Attack stat cannot be lowered by other Pokémon.

dazzling.name: Dazzling
dazzling.shortDesc: Makes foes unable to use priority attacks.
dazzling.desc: When user is on the field, opponent's priority moves that target the user and/or its allies will be nullified.

packedsnow.name: Packed Snow
packedsnow.shortDesc: Halves effectiveness of S/E moves in Hail.
packedsnow.desc: User takes 0.5x damage from super-effective moves during Hail. User takes no damage from Hail.

deepchill.name: Deep Chill
deepchill.shortDesc: Special moves may frostbite the attacker.
deepchill.desc: When user is hit by a special move, there's a 30% chance to frostbite the attacker.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.shortDesc: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.
analytic.desc: When user moves after all other Pokémon on the field, their moves deal 1.3x damage.

shedskin.name: Shed Skin
shedskin.shortDesc: The Pokémon may heal its own status problems.
shedskin.desc: User has 1/3 chance of automatically recovering from any non-volatile status effects it's suffering from at the end of each turn.

shielddust.name: Shield Dust
shielddust.shortDesc: Blocks the added effects of attacks taken.
shielddust.desc: Blocks the added effects of attacks taken.

battlearmor.name: Battle Armor
battlearmor.shortDesc: Prevents crits and 1.2x Pokémon's SpDef stat.
battlearmor.desc: Attacks against the user will never be critical hits. User has 1.2x Special Defense against special moves.

sandforce.name: Sand Force
sandforce.shortDesc: Boosts moves' power in a sandstorm.
sandforce.desc: User's moves deal 1.3x damage during a Sandstorm. User takes no damage from Sandstorm.

noguard.name: No Guard
noguard.shortDesc: Ensures attacks by or against the Pokémon land.
noguard.desc: Attacks used by or against the user will ignore accuracy checks to always hit. If user is in the lead, increases wild Pokémon encounter rate by 100%.

fairyaura.name: Fairy Aura
fairyaura.shortDesc: Powers up each Pokémon's Fairy-type moves.
fairyaura.desc: When user is on the field, all Pokémon on both sides deal 1.33x damage with Fairy-type moves. Multiple instances of this ability will not stack.

icescales.name: Ice Scales
icescales.shortDesc: Halves the damage taken from special moves.
icescales.desc: Halves the damage taken from special moves.

flashfire.name: Flash Fire
flashfire.shortDesc: It powers up Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.
flashfire.desc: User is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time they're hit by a Fire-type move, their own Fire-type moves will deal 1.5x damage until they switch out. If user is in the lead, has 50% chance to force wild encounters to be Fire types.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.shortDesc: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
reckless.desc: Moves with recoil or crash damage deal 1.2x damage.

flareboost.name: Flare Boost
flareboost.shortDesc: Burn does 1/2 damage and ups special attacks.
flareboost.desc: User's special attacks deal 1.5x damage when burned. User takes halved damage from burns.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.shortDesc: Makes the foe nervous and unable to eat Berries.
unnerve.desc: Makes the foe nervous and unable to eat Berries.

cursedbody.name: Cursed Body
cursedbody.shortDesc: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.
cursedbody.desc: When user is hit by a damaging move, there's a 30% chance to disable the attacker's move.

wanderingspirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wanderingspirit.shortDesc: Taking a contact hit exchanges Abilities.
wanderingspirit.desc: Taking a contact hit exchanges Abilities.

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.desc: User's Electric-type moves deal 1.5x damage. Stacks multiplicatively with STAB.

toxicdebris.name: Toxic Debris
toxicdebris.shortDesc: Scatters poison spikes upon physical hit.
toxicdebris.desc: When hit by a physical move, user sets up Toxic Spikes on the enemy side of the field.

emergencyexit.name: Emergency Exit
emergencyexit.shortDesc: Switches out if its HP becomes half or less.
emergencyexit.desc: When the user's HP is reduced to half or less, the user switches out or escapes at the end of the turn.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.shortDesc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in sunshine.
chlorophyll.desc: User's Speed stat is doubled during Harsh Sunlight.

healer.name: Healer
healer.desc: User has a 50% chance to cure any adjacent allies' non-volatile status effects at the end of each turn.

strongjaw.name: Strong Jaw
strongjaw.shortDesc: Boosts the power of biting moves.
strongjaw.desc: User's moves with the Biting flag deal 1.5x damage.

berserk.name: Berserk

berserk.desc: Ups SpAtk if a hit makes its HP half or less.

slushrush.name: Slush Rush
slushrush.shortDesc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a hailstorm.
slushrush.desc: User's Speed stat is doubled during Hail. User takes no damage from Hail.

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.shortDesc: Inflicts damage to the foe on special hit.
feedback.desc: When user is hit by a special move, attacker takes damage equal to 1/8 of their max HP.

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.shortDesc: Immunity to poison moves and being poisoned.
immunity.desc: User is immune to Poison-type moves, cannot be poisoned or badly poisoned, and also cures said statuses if already inflicted.

raindish.name: Rain Dish
raindish.shortDesc: The Pokémon gradually regains 1/8 max HP in rain.
raindish.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains 1/8 max HP in rain.

furcoat.name: Fur Coat
furcoat.shortDesc: Halves the damage from physical moves.
furcoat.desc: Halves the damage from physical moves.

colorchange.name: Color Change
colorchange.shortDesc: Changes the Pokémon's type to the foe's move.
colorchange.desc: When user is hit by a damaging move of a type different from their current ones, their typing will change into a single type of the same type as the attack.

compoundeyes.name: Compound Eyes
compoundeyes.desc: User's moves have 1.3x Accuracy. If user is in the lead, increases chances of wild encounters carrying an item.

magnetpull.name: Magnet Pull
magnetpull.desc: When user is on the field, adjacent enemy Steel types cannot switch out or escape. If user is in the lead, has 50% chance to force wild encounters to be Steel types.

flowerveil.name: Flower Veil
flowerveil.shortDesc: Protects Grass-type allies from stat/status effects.
flowerveil.desc: When user is on the field, all Grass-type allies including the user become immune to stat drops inflicted from other Pokémon, as well as non-volatile status effects.

solidrock.name: Solid Rock
solidrock.desc: User takes 0.75x damage from super-effective attacks.

rockhead.name: Rock Head
rockhead.shortDesc: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
rockhead.desc: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

irradiate.name: Irradiate
irradiate.shortDesc: Powers up Light-type moves in a pinch.
irradiate.desc: User's Light-type moves deal 1.5x damage when they have 1/3 or less HP remaining.

charisma.name: Charisma
charisma.shortDesc: On KO, SpAtk is boosted once per switch-in.
charisma.desc: On KO, SpAtk is boosted once per switch-in.

aromaveil.name: Aroma Veil

aromaveil.desc: When user is on the field, all allies including the user cannot be disabled, infatuated, taunted, encored, heal blocked, or tormented.

neutralizinggas.name: Neutralizing Gas
neutralizinggas.shortDesc: Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
neutralizinggas.desc: Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

steadfast.name: Steadfast

steadfast.desc: When user moves before their target, their moves deal 1.3x damage.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.shortDesc: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.
telepathy.desc: Dodges damaging spread moves an ally uses that hits the user.

toxicboost.name: Toxic Boost

toxicboost.desc: User's physical attacks deal 1.5x damage when poisoned or badly poisoned. User takes halved damage from poison and bad poison.

poisonheal.name: Poison Heal
poisonheal.shortDesc: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned.
poisonheal.desc: User takes no damage from poison and bad poison and is healed by 1/8 max HP each turn instead.

arenatrap.name: Arena Trap
arenatrap.desc: When user is on the field, adjacent grounded enemies cannot switch out or escape. If user is in the lead, increases wild Pokémon encounter rate by 100%.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.shortDesc: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.
drizzle.desc: User summons Rain for 5 turns when entering the field, unless Rain is already present.

lightningrod.name: Lightning Rod

lightningrod.desc: User redirects all single target Electric-type moves towards itself and is immune to Electric-type moves, when hit by an Electric-type move their Special Attack is increased by one stage. If user is in the lead, has 50% chance to force wild encounters to be Electric types.

quickfeet.name: Quick Feet

fortification.name: Fortification
fortification.shortDesc: Ups Def and SpDef if a hit makes its HP <50%.
fortification.desc: Ups Def and SpDef if a hit makes its HP <50%.

gooey.name: Gooey

gooey.desc: Contact with it lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

pickpocket.desc: When user is not holding an item and is hit by a contact move, user steals the attacker's held item.

psychicsurge.name: Psychic Surge

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.shortDesc: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type and powered up.
pixilate.desc: User's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type and deal 1.2x damage.

honeygather.name: Honey Gather
honeygather.shortDesc: Gradually regains 1/16 max HP each turn.
honeygather.desc: Gradually regains 1/16 max HP each turn. After a battle, the user has a 5% chance for every 10 levels to generate Honey if they are not already holding an item.

triage.name: Triage
triage.shortDesc: Gives priority to a healing move.
triage.desc: Recovery and HP draining moves get +3 priority.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.desc: When user enters the field, it will shudder if any opponent has a move that is super-effective against it.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.shortDesc: Passes its held item to an ally that has used theirs.
symbiosis.desc: Passes its held item to an ally that has used theirs.

windfury.name: Wind Fury
windfury.shortDesc: Boosts wind moves 30%/ Reduces Wind dmg 50%.
windfury.desc: User's moves with the Wind flag deal 1.3x damage. User takes 0.5x damage from moves with the Wind flag.

nebulacloud.name: Nebula Cloud
nebulacloud.desc: When user is on the field, all Cosmic-type allies including the user become immune to stat drops inflicted from other Pokémon, as well as non-volatile status effects.

waterbubble.name: Water Bubble
waterbubble.desc: User's Water-type moves deal 2x damage. User takes 0.5x damage from Fire-type moves and cannot be burned.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.shortDesc: It transforms itself into the Pokémon it is facing.
imposter.desc: It transforms itself into the Pokémon it is facing.

lightbulb.name: Light Bulb
lightbulb.shortDesc: Weakens incoming Dark moves, 2x Light moves
lightbulb.desc: User's Light-type moves deal 2x damage. User takes 0.5x damage from Dark-type moves.

magician.name: Magician
magician.shortDesc: Steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits.
magician.desc: When user is not holding an item and attacks a target, user steals the target's held item.

zenmode.name: Zen Mode
zenmode.shortDesc: Changes the Pokémon's shape when HP is halved.
zenmode.desc: When HP is reduced to 50% or less, user changes to Zen Mode. This form has reduced Speed but increased defenses.

tropicalhide.name: Tropical Hide
tropicalhide.shortDesc: Halves damage from Grass and Water-type moves.
tropicalhide.desc: Halves damage from Grass and Water-type moves.

propellertail.name: Propeller Tail
propellertail.shortDesc: Ignores effects that change the target of a move.
propellertail.desc: Ignores effects that change the target of a move.

funeralpyre.name: Funeral Pyre
funeralpyre.desc: User's Ghost-type and Fire-type moves deal 2x damage. Stacks multiplicatively with STAB.

deltastream.name: Delta Stream
deltastream.shortDesc: Alters weather to remove Flying-type's weaknesses.
deltastream.desc: Alters weather to remove Flying-type's weaknesses.

thermalexchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermalexchange.desc: When user is hit by either a Fire-type or Ice-Type move, their Attack and Special Attack both raise by one stage. Prevents the user from being Burned and Frostbitten, it also cures said statuses if already inflicted.

arsonist.name: Arsonist
arsonist.desc: User's Fire-type moves deal 1.5x damage. Stacks multiplicatively with STAB.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.shortDesc: Copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
receiver.desc: Copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

terrorize.name: Terrorize
terrorize.shortDesc: Weakens incoming Bug moves, 2x Psychic moves
terrorize.desc: User's Psychic-type moves deal 2x damage. User takes 0.5x damage from Bug-type moves.

affection.name: Affection
affection.desc: User's Fairy-type moves deal 1.5x damage. Stacks multiplicatively with STAB.

prismarmor.name: Prism Armor
prismarmor.desc: User takes 0.75x damage from super-effective attacks.

queenlymajesty.name: Queenly Majesty
queenlymajesty.shortDesc: Makes foes unable to use priority attacks.
queenlymajesty.desc: When user is on the field, opponent's priority moves that target the user and/or its allies will be nullified.
